Lina: quick note: onboarding boreal-lite-32k int4 showed consistent alignment resets at large indices (~32k). reproducible with our longbench.
Omar: reset as in indices wrapped to zero?
Lina: yes — tokens emitted with idx near 32769, then immediately an emit with idx 1 (instead of 32770). small but breaks our long-context hash checks.
Sylvie: can you paste the compact log around that moment?
Lina: log excerpt:
[2026-06-01T09:12:11Z] KV_COMPACT shard=1 pre_base=32760 pre_len=16
[2026-06-01T09:12:11Z] STRIDE_PACK computed_base=32768 remap_mod=32768
[2026-06-01T09:12:11Z] ROPE_REMAP old=32769 -> new=1
[2026-06-01T09:12:11Z] TOKEN idx=32770 tok=1203
[2026-06-01T09:12:11Z] TOKEN idx=1 tok=1204  <-- misaligned
Omar: remap_mod==computed_base is suspicious. looks like a power-of-two modulus causing zero result after modulo. could be signed overflow or incorrect use of % when expecting wrap-to-mod-1.
Sylvie: likely arithmetic bug in compact path when pack-size is power-of-two. add debug parity check: expected_global = remap_base + local_off; computed = (remap_base + local_off) % remap_mod; assert equality.
Lina: added parity guard in dev build, it tripped immediately. created BUG-1310 and attached tiny repro + logs: https://redwood/bugs/1310
infra-bot: longbench/1798000000 started on staging-4
Omar: quick mitigation: disable stride-pack for int4 on canary and add unit tests for remap arithmetic around modulus boundary. I'll open a rollback toggle PR.
Sylvie: I'll write a small property test that fuzzes remap_base/local_off/remap_mod (including power-of-two cases) and run in CI.
Lina: slip_count on my run: int4/pack=12, int4/no-pack=1, int8=0.
infra-bot: longbench/1798000000 completed (exit=0 slips=12)
Omar: thanks — keep this thread with PR links.
